## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results, following the change-type matrix in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/aniaisec/inter-cua/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#choose-checks-for-the-change). Explain any
unavailable environment or skipped cases. Pure prose changes need link/command
checks; live adapter changes need the relevant platform evidence.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any effect on configuration, schemas, feature claims, approval/hash
compatibility, results or retry/commit behavior, or state that none apply.
Link relevant docs/changelog updates. Review the diff for secrets, tokens and
private runtime evidence before submitting.
